**Student Assistant, People & Culture Operations

**Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Student Assistant to join our People & Culture Operations team at our HQ in Ballerup, Denmark.

As our Student Assistant, you will become part of the team supporting more than 600 colleagues with day-to-day People & Culture matters at Ambu's headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark. Working closely with experienced P&C colleagues, you will gain hands-on experience across the employee lifecycle, HR systems and data, employee administration and operational P&C processes.

You will support the team in ensuring employee data and documentation are accurate and up to date, help coordinate recurring P&C activities, and assist employees and managers with day-to-day questions. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to process improvements and smaller P&C projects.

As you develop in the role, we would like you to gradually take independent ownership of smaller processes and recurring tasks, giving you the opportunity to build both your P&C knowledge and professional experience.

The position is expected to be 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility to accommodate your studies.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

**Employee Lifecycle and Data Management

**

• Maintain and update employee data in our HRIS, SuccessFactors, and support high data quality

• Support the preparation of employment documentation and administrative employee changes

• Coordinate and support employee onboarding and offboarding activities

• Assist with administration related to holidays, leave and other employee lifecycle processes

• Prepare reports, data extracts and other operational material

• Support recurring data checks and administrative activities

**P&C Operations and Employee Support

**

• Support employees and managers with day-to-day P&C questions and requests

• Maintain P&C documentation, guidelines and internal information

• Support recurring P&C activities and larger processes throughout the year, such as salary review and bonus processes

• Provide general administrative support to the P&C Operations team

• Gradually take ownership of selected recurring tasks and smaller P&C processes

**Process Improvement and Projects

**

• Help identify opportunities to simplify and improve our P&C processes

• Support smaller P&C projects and operational initiatives

• Build your understanding of the broader P&C function by working with colleagues across different P&C areas and initiatives

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we do not expect you to know everything before joining us. We imagine that you:

• Are currently studying and are interested in gaining practical experience within People & Culture. Studies within HR, Business Administration, Economics or a related area would be an advantage, but are not a requirement

• Are structured and comfortable keeping track of several tasks and deadlines

• Have strong attention to detail and enjoy working with data

• Are comfortable using Microsoft Office, and curious about learning HR systems and other digital tools

• Take responsibility for your tasks and are motivated to gradually work more independently

• Have a proactive and service-minded approach when working with employees, managers and colleagues

• Are curious, eager to learn and not afraid to ask questions

• Communicate confidently in English. Knowledge of Danish would be an advantage, but is not required

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success, and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Manager for the Drug Product Development and Analysis Team
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where you can explore scientific challenges and have a significant impact? Are you passionate about developing life-saving vaccines, and enjoy close collaboration and leading a small development team?

We are expanding and looking for a new Manager to support our development projects!

**Join our team and let us make a difference together

**Our Process Development department in Hørsholm develops and optimizes vaccine production processes and supports our production sites. The Department handles diverse and evolving tasks and includes 32 members across 4 specialized teams.

We are looking for a manager to head our Drug Product Development and Analysis Team, consisting of three Scientists and three Technicians reporting to the Head of Process Development. The team focuses on drug product process and formulation development, stability studies, and analyzing development samples for ongoing programs.

Apart from managing the team an important part of the role will be hands-on to review analytical results, maintain the analytical methods and drive the execution of the analytical tasks in the team.

“We look forward to welcoming you to a dedicated and engaged department, where we value good team spirit and an easy-going, humorous environment,” says Janus Falhof, Head of Process Development.

**Your Impact

**You must have a strong interest in consistently delivering high-quality analytical data and to support the department’s development studies. Given the function of the team, there will be close interaction with all the teams in the department.

Your tasks will include:

• Driving the daily operation of the team, setting the scientific direction, and ensuring the development of the team members

• Ensuring established analysis assays run smoothly and deliver high-quality data on time, while supporting the team in developing new assays to advance the department

• Communicating daily with the team and collaborating closely with Production, Quality Control, and R&D

**Are You Our Next Pioneer?

**To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

• M.S. in Biotechnology, Human Biology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field, preferably with a PhD in protein chemistry or a related topic

• 3-5 years of relevant experience from the biotech industry or academia Previous experience with pharmaceutical analyses, e.g. chromatographic methods, particle methods and protein methods

• Previous experience with formulation development, statistical data analysis, and an understanding of protein chemistry

• Fluency in spoken and written English is required

**Who Are You?

**You are self-driven, responsible, and approach scientific challenges with curiosity and innovation. Success relies on strong teamwork, people skills, and the ability to engage in cross-functional dialogue. A proactive, calm, and positive attitude, combined with adaptability to new priorities, is beneficial. Good teamwork abilities are essential in a diverse, international department.

**Why join us?

**

• Be part of a team that directly contributes to global health by manufacturing and developing life-saving vaccines

• Your work here has a visible and significant impact, ensuring the safety and well-being of millions

• Join the fascinating field of vaccine production, where every day brings new challenges and opportunities to protect public health

• Enjoy a vibrant staff club that offers a variety of diverse, fun, and exciting events

**Are you ready to join us in our mission?

**If this sounds like the next step in your career, we would love to hear from you.

We look forward to receiving your application together with your CV. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

_Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

**Description

**Factbird is a manufacturing intelligence suite that turns real-time production data into actionable insights. Our plug-and-play hardware and AI-powered SaaS solution help manufacturers cut downtime, improve efficiency and reduce waste. We are around 100 people across Europe and the US, growing more than 50% year over year. We have just partnered with the private equity firm Verdane to strengthen our product roadmap and expand our reach even further.

We have built a solid Revenue Operations foundation, with HubSpot as our CRM, BigQuery as our data warehouse, and Power BI and Claude for reporting that the leadership team and the board rely on. Now we want to take the next step. We are looking for a Revenue Operations Manager who doesn't just keep the engine running, but tells us where to steer it.

This is a role for someone who looks at our numbers and asks "so what?" Which segments should we double down on? Where is the funnel leaking? Which investments will pay back? What can we do even better? You will help answer those questions and make sure the answers lead to action.

**The role

**You will own Revenue Operations across the full customer journey, from the first marketing touch to sales, onboarding, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to unify the processes, technology, and data behind our revenue teams so that growth becomes more predictable, transparent, and scalable.

You will be based at our office at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, report to the CFO, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and the senior leadership team. You will lead our Business Intelligence Analyst, who owns the data warehouse, the data pipelines, and the Power BI dashboards.

You will thrive here if you combine a commercial mindset with analytical rigor, and you enjoy turning a messy question into a clear recommendation that a leadership team can act on.

**What You'll Do

**Planning and GTM

• Turn performance, customer, and market data into clear recommendations: where to invest, which segments and industries to prioritize, and what isn't working.

• Support commercial planning with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, including targets, quotas, and capacity planning.

• Support sales leadership on territory design, lead routing, and pipeline coverage.

Data and Intelligence

• Develop the commercial KPIs that matter across the funnel, such as pipeline, conversion, win rates, CAC, churn, and net revenue retention, and understand the data behind it.

• Own the monthly commercial performance reporting for the leadership team and present the story and learnings behind the numbers.

• Lead deep-dive analyses, such as ICP and industry performance, win/loss and churn drivers, and recommend corrective actions.

• Lead and develop our Business Intelligence Analyst: set priorities, goals, and development plans.

Best in Class Processes

• Map our processes from lead to renewal, find the bottlenecks, and fix them together with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

• Design workflows and hand-offs that cut admin time and improve data quality for Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

Technology and AI

• Foster the adoption of AI across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success: connect AI assistants to our CRM and data, and build AI-powered workflows for enrichment, lead scoring and reporting. AI-powered tools in our current stack include Gong, Amplemarket, Claude and Dreamdata.

• Measure the impact of AI and automation on productivity and pipeline.

Revenue Funnel Pursuit

• Give the revenue teams the insights, tools and cadences they need at every stage of the funnel, from demand generation to renewal and expansion.

• Support Marketing on attribution, intent data and campaign reporting.

• Support Customer Success with health, churn-risk and expansion insights.

Project Management

• Plan and deliver cross-functional revenue projects from scope to measurable impact.

• Lead the change management that comes with new processes and tools, so they stick.

**What We're Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded problem solver who uses data to drive decisions and create value. You understand what drives growth in a B2B business, you are comfortable in front of a leadership team, and you are hands-on enough to get into HubSpot yourself.

The ideal background

• 5 to 7 years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, commercial analytics, strategy or management consulting, or a similar role.

• Experience from a B2B SaaS or tech scale-up, where you have seen what drives growth up close.

• A proven track record of turning data into insights and recommendations that leaders acted on.

• Strong analytical skills: you may have been a Business Intelligence Analyst in the past. You are definitely at home with funnel metrics, unit economics and forecasting, and you can build a model in Excel or a BI tool.

• Solid HubSpot experience and you will need to be confident as its Super Admin.

• Curiosity about AI, and practical experience using it to automate work or get more out of data.

• Clear communication in English, written and spoken, at leadership and board level.

How you work

• You think like a business owner and always ask what a number means for growth.

• You work autonomously, take ownership, and see what could be better before anyone asks. You help the teams around you turn those ideas into real improvements.

• You build trust across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, and you can challenge with facts.

• You enjoy coaching others and want to develop the analyst on your team.

• You like structure, but you are happy to build it where it doesn't exist yet.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams - and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

__We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity

**The Clients & Industries (C&I) Revenue Planning Lead will have overall global oversight and leadership of the Global C&I Revenue Planning Team within the Enablement & Technology domain. The role will team closely with Global and Region Clients & Industries Leadership and domains on cross-functional initiatives and translate EY’s strategic priorities into the revenue planning business process.

The role will lead the continued evolution of global sales and revenue planning, strengthening the processes, governance and capabilities that connect account-level growth ambitions with regional and global business priorities. Working across markets, service lines and strategic growth areas, the role will help translate growth ambitions into actionable sales and revenue plans, focusing on topline growth, where and how the business will grow. It does not own P&L, financial forecasting, budgeting or expense planning, which remain Finance responsibilities.

Serve as the primary relationship lead to Global and Region leadership, connecting sales and revenue planning priorities with broader business objectives, enabling alignment, strengthening adoption, and accelerating decisions.

This includes active management of all sales and revenue planning business processes globally, aligned to and informed by evolving business needs. The role will collaborate with teams to identify and enable opportunities to use AI and advanced technologies to improve planning effectiveness, decision support, process efficiency and user adoption across the revenue planning lifecycle. The role will also have a hands-on delivery role across the range of sales and revenue planning activities.

The role will be responsible for performance management of the Revenue Planning Team, including LEAD counselor responsibilities and the integration of GDS resource capability.

As a key member of the Enablement & Technology domain, the role will collaborate on a broader set of Global Clients & Industries priorities and may act as sponsor for agreed strategic initiatives.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**Some or all the below will be applicable depending on the scope and team alignment of the role.

• 
Sales & Revenue Planning

• 
Continue to build, refine, and manage sales and revenue planning

• 
Implement and maintain consistency of sales and revenue planning governance globally

• 
Establish trusted, long-term relationships with senior leaders to understand their priorities and translate them into coordinated revenue planning actions

• 
Shape and sustain strategic stakeholder alignment across Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation, Industry, and Client Excellence, providing strategic leadership and influence to align cross-functional priorities to enable a consistent global revenue planning process

• 
Participate in and contribute to efforts to ensure consistency of integrated planning processes and protocols across Clients & Industries, Finance, Regions, Services Lines, Growth & Innovation, and IT

• 
Process improvement

• 
Guide the evolution of revenue planning toward a process to enhance strategic decision- making

• 
Collaborate with Finance to identify relevant, consistent revenue planning, analysis for senior stakeholders (i.e., GE, GPG, GMIC, Clients & Industries Leadership)

• 
Operationalize and implement on a consistent basis; identify trends and issues and present recommendations as warranted

• 
Leverage AI and advanced technologies to streamline revenue planning processes, improve data quality and insight generation, and increase efficiency, accuracy and decision support

• 
Effective teaming

• 
Deliver inclusive and trusted leadership and coaching at all levels to ensure all Revenue Planning team members achieve their highest potential both individually and collectively

• 
Manage, mentor and counsel Revenue Planning team members, as appropriate

• 
Leverage and elevate GDS resource capability across the Clients & Industries revenue planning landscape

• 
Manage Clients & Industries and other EY stakeholder relationships - Clients & Industries pillar leaders, Finance, Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation - and identify opportunities for effective collaboration

• 
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:

• 
Apply in-depth knowledge of the business and resources, leveraging relationships, communications and operational effectiveness to anticipate, drive and deliver complex revenue planning

• 
Provide strategic revenue planning insight and guidance to leadership

• 
Possess a high level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability

• 
Convert planning data or abstract concepts into sharp, compelling management information reporting

• 
Create and implement timelines related to project deliverables, assign tasks, drive their completion and manage sponsor/stakeholder expectations of the outcomes

• 
Manage highly complex relationships with multiple stakeholders

• 
Make decisions regarding project resource and funding needs

• 
Supervision Responsibilities:

• 
Lead, coach and develop the Revenue Planning team

• 
Develop a culture of success by leading and driving the execution of high-performing, diverse and inclusive talent management (hiring, developing, assessing, etc)

• 
LEAD Reviewer responsibilities and provision of mentoring and regular feedback

• 
Develop and maintain metrics on team performance, providing regular feedback in LEAD and publicizing the teams’ contributions to leadership and other relevant stakeholders

• 
Instil high performing teaming principles

• 
Operate with high degree of independency and autonomy

**Skills And Attributes For Success

**

• In-depth knowledge of the EY business and working in a global partnership

• Strong influencing and consensus-building capability in a complex, matrixed organization where success depends on partnership rather than direct authority

• Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility quickly across functions, geographies, and leadership levels

• Experience in large transformation programs within a global environment and/or successfully transforming business functions. This includes demonstrated change leadership skills around disruption and increasing business agility, innovation and adoption

• High level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability, a wide sphere of influence and a broad-based network are expected

• Financial acumen with demonstrable ability to analyze business reporting and develop business insights

• Demonstrates technology acumen, comfortable with AI and automation

• Proven track record of leading global virtual teams

• Demonstrated drive, determination and resilience, and track record of being able to overcome barriers and achieve results

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with a global mindset and ability to communicate and work effectively across culture

• Understanding of and desire to strive for technical excellence and commercial impact

• Demonstrated experience working at a senior level in a fast-moving, client-driven environment

• Strong executive presence and ability to build and sustain stakeholder relationships at the highest levels of the firm with the ability to quickly establish personal credibility and influence

• Resilient, agile, and pragmatic under pressure

**To qualify for the role, you must have:

**

• Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent qualification required

• 10-12 years of experience leading complex, large-scale transformation initiatives, preferably within sales, commercial, finance or enterprise planning functions.

**Ideally, you should also be prepared for the following:

**

• Travel may be required from time to time to complete assignments and meet with organizational leaders and stakeholders

• Flexibility in working hours to accommodate volume of work and multiple time zones as needed

**What We Offer You

The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $129,500 to $249,200. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $155,300 to $283,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

• Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.

• Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

jobs.occupation: Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description:
**Lead a global compliance function and help shape how compliance enables the business

**Are you an experienced compliance, privacy or GRC leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of regulation, business and technology?

Do you thrive in a role where you can set direction, lead experienced professionals, advise Executive Management and the Board, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions?

Then this could be your opportunity to lead Aeven's Group Compliance function.

**The role

**As Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer, you will lead the Global Group Compliance organisation of approximately 27 professionals across four teams and three countries.

You will have overall responsibility for the strategy, direction and development of the function, covering:

• Group Data Protection and the DPO function

• Regulatory Compliance

• Enterprise Risk Management

• Internal Audit

• ISO and external assurance

• Customer and supplier assurance

• Responsibility / ESG

You will lead primarily through your managers, creating clear priorities and accountability while empowering highly specialised teams to own their areas.

The role combines strategic leadership, independent oversight and senior business advisory. You will work closely with Executive Management and the Board, providing a consolidated view of Aeven's compliance, privacy, risk and assurance position and highlighting where action or decisions are required.

At the same time, you will work closely with the business to translate regulatory and customer requirements into clear, proportionate and commercially workable solutions.

****Your responsibilities

• Set the strategy, priorities and roadmap for Group Compliance and lead, coach and develop the management team.

• Advise Executive Management and the Board on significant compliance, privacy and risk matters and provide clear, decision-oriented Management Information.

• Act as Group DPO and oversee Aeven's data protection framework, including significant privacy risks, breaches, regulatory engagement and international transfers.

• Lead the organisation's approach to regulatory developments, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA-related customer requirements, AI Act, Data Act and digital sovereignty.

• Own the Enterprise Risk Management framework and consolidated enterprise risk view, while ensuring risk ownership remains with the business.

• Oversee Internal Audit and Aeven's broader certification and assurance landscape, including ISO and ISAE activities.

• Provide senior oversight of customer and supplier due diligence, audits and regulatory assurance requirements.

• Support significant incidents, investigations, escalations and remediation across the organisation.

• Continuously develop and modernise the function through simplification, automation, better Management Information and effective use of compliance technology.

A key part of the role is ensuring that compliance enables the business rather than unnecessarily slowing it down.

****Your experience

****We are looking for an experienced leader who is comfortable operating where regulation, risk and business strategy meet.

You bring:

• A relevant Master's degree, for example in Law, Business/Commercial Law or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience within compliance, data protection, GRC or a related area, including several years leading managers and international or multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong GDPR and data protection expertise, including DPO experience.

• Proven experience advising C-level executives and Boards and communicating complex risks through clear Management Information.

• Experience with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit and assurance.

• Working knowledge of ISO management systems (ISO9001, ISO27001 and ISO14001) and ideally ISAE 3000/3402 reporting.

• Knowledge of EU digital and cyber regulation, including NIS2, DORA, AI Act and Data Act.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international, regulated or technology-driven organisation is an advantage, as is experience with privacy certification, GRC technology, customer assurance, ESG or transformation.

**Who You Are

**You are a trusted and credible advisor who can challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building strong relationships across the organisation.

You lead through trust, clear direction and empowerment, and enjoy developing managers and creating high-performing teams.

You are strategic but pragmatic, with strong business understanding and the judgement to balance regulatory robustness with commercial realities.

You communicate complex issues simply, drive follow-through and are comfortable raising risks and challenging established ways of working.

Most importantly, you bring integrity, sound judgement, independence and a genuine desire to make compliance work for the business.

**Why Aeven?

**This is an opportunity to take on a broad and influential leadership role at the centre of Aeven's governance and business operations.

You will lead a highly skilled international team, work directly with senior leadership and the Board, and help shape how a technology-driven organisation responds to an increasingly complex regulatory environment.

If you are motivated by leadership, influence, complexity and the opportunity to make compliance a genuine business enabler, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Associate Project Director, Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about translating strategic priorities into disciplined execution? Do you have extensive experience leading complex, cross-functional projects in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry? If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Project Director, GRAPS.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an experienced and highly structured Associate Project Director to join our GRAPS Enablement & Insights function within Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety.

In this role, you will translate GRAPS priorities into integrated plans and disciplined execution across Global Regulatory Affairs, Global Patient Safety, and key enterprise functions. You will lead strategic and operational initiatives involving multiple functions, geographies, vendors, and systems, while establishing clear governance, decision pathways, performance reporting, and risk management.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine strategic perspective with hands-on project leadership in a global and highly regulated environment. You will work closely with the GRAPS Leadership Team, functional leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen quality, compliance, predictability, and organizational scalability.

You will join the GRAPS team (Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety) and report directly to Jethro Ekuta, Chief Regulatory & Safety Officer, who is based in US.

The position may be based in US or DK, with travel to Ascendis Pharma locations and other business-critical meetings as required.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead assigned GRAPS projects and programs from initiation through closeout, establishing clear scope, objectives, governance, integrated plans, milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, budgets, risk controls, and measurable outcomes

• Partner with GRAPS leaders to translate strategic priorities into roadmaps and sequenced execution plans, while maintaining a consolidated view of the GRAPS project portfolio, including capacity constraints, interdependencies, risks, and decisions requiring leadership attention

• Establish and facilitate fit-for-purpose governance, steering forums, workshops, stage reviews, and decision-making processes, and prepare concise executive dashboards, status reports, decision materials, and recommendations

• Coordinate stakeholders across Regulatory Affairs, Patient Safety, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Quality, IT, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, and external partners, creating clarity around roles, responsibilities, interfaces, and handoffs

• Drive operational excellence and sustainable change by identifying opportunities to standardize, simplify, and scale processes, tools, and ways of working while supporting applicable GxP, regulatory, pharmacovigilance, documentation, training, inspection-readiness, and records-management requirements

You will also provide project-methodology guidance and coaching to workstream leads and more junior project-management colleagues and may coordinate contractors or matrixed team members.

Qualifications and skills

You hold a relevant academic degree, preferably a bachelor's or master's degree in life sciences, business, project management, engineering, or a related discipline, and have at least 8 years of relevant experience from the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or another highly regulated industry.

Furthermore, you have:

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects, programs, or major workstreams involving senior stakeholders, multiple functions, geographies, vendors, or systems

• Strong command of project and program management disciplines, including scope, schedule, governance, resources, budgets, dependencies, risks, issues, change control, and benefits realization

• Working knowledge of drug development and commercialization, preferably combined with experience in Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Patient Safety, Quality, Regulatory Operations, or a closely related function

• Experience creating executive-ready dashboards, status reports, decision materials, and presentations using Microsoft 365 and relevant project-management or reporting tools

• A project-management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent is preferred. Agile or change-management training would be considered an advantage

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. jobs.description:
Are you experienced in managing CMO collaborations and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders? Do you thrive in a broad QA role where you combine your GMP expertise with a pragmatic and hands-on approach across different quality areas?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new QA Specialist in QA Commercial Operations.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate QA specialist to join our team. You will be a part of the well-functioning QA Drug Substance/QA for QC team in the QA Commercial Operations department, with responsibility for quality oversight of starting materials, intermediates, and Drug Substances for commercial products. We have a close collaboration with our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and process- and QC SMEs internally at Ascendis Pharma.

Your key responsibilities will be:

As part of the role, you will work broadly across quality oversight activities and take ownership of a wide range of tasks and responsibilities, including:

• Take primary responsibility for oversight of one or more CMOs in our supply chains with respect to review and approval of documentation from these CMOs, including upscale activities, PPQ documentation, CPVs, batch documentation, deviations, changes, CAPAs, stability studies, QMRs, quality agreements etc

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key CMO stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and effective collaboration through meetings, teleconferences, and audits. Participate in CMO evaluations and product quality reviews

• Keep up to date with changes in relevant product guidelines and regulatory requirements and ensure cGMP at Ascendis and CMOs

• Drive and assume responsibility for agreed tasks and matters

• Continuously optimize our work processes and the way we execute quality oversight

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a master's degree in pharmacy or equivalent - and 5-10 years of experience within chemical and/or biological GMP production

Furthermore, you have:

• Solid QA experience, preferably including QA for QC, and experience working with CMOs

• Strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a can-do attitude

• Cultural understanding

• Experience with audits/inspections

• A critical and pragmatic mindset and yet with attention to the necessary details

• Clear and persistent communication skills, particular regarding expectations and requirements to quality

• Cooperative and striving for smooth cooperation with many stakeholders

• Ambitious and able to see the benefits in going the extra mile

The position as QA specialist requires experience with and knowledge of US and EU GMP regulations and requirements. Furthermore, you should be proficient in English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office.

At Ascendis Pharma, you will be part of a stimulating, informal, and innovative working environment, where you will interact with very skilled colleagues and partners to deliver on Ascendis' ambitious corporate goals. You will be part of an expanding QA-organization overseeing development, clinical, and commercial activities.

Travel: 5-20 days/year.

Place of work: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the job or the company, please contact QA Senior Director, Jan Jakobsgaard, M +45 25 66 29 42 leave a message if call is not answered. All applications must be submitted in English and are treated confidentially.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

**Team

**The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

**Role

**The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

• Build and maintain networks of AI champions and subject matter experts, promoting a culture of experimentation and responsible AI usage.

**You

**You have a relevant educational background within business, data science, technology, or a similar field. In addition, you have a good understanding of business processes, operating models, and digital transformation, and 5+ years of experience working with technology transformation, AI, data, automation, or similar initiatives, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical AI opportunities and outcomes.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Good stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable translating between business and technology audiences to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical business value.

• Experience driving change, adoption, and organizational enablement initiatives.

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Curious, business-oriented, and outcome-focused.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is motivated by delivering measurable impact through technology-enabled change.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

**CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

**CIP Fund Solutions

**CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.
